short: The AI company that built the Pi personal assistant, focused on empathetic conversation.
definition: Inflection AI is an AI company founded in 2022 by Mustafa Suleyman, Reid Hoffman, and Karen Simonyan. It built Pi, a personal AI assistant designed for empathetic conversation. In 2024 much of its team, including Suleyman, moved to Microsoft, and the company rebuilt itself as a smaller enterprise AI provider under new leadership, offering business-focused tools built on its own Inflection models while continuing to run Pi as a free consumer product on the side.
